thread:
Mina: observed a priority inversion in the gateway: many short, idempotent RPCs starved by long-running streams during peak. p95 spiked.
Eli: are streams occupying worker slots or queue slots?
Mina: both. long streams hold a worker while open and never yield admission tokens.
Harper: quick thought: split admission into two dimensions: connection weight (worker slots) and request weight (queue tokens). streams get heavy connection weight but can be light on request tokens if idle.
Eli: how to detect streaming cheaply? opt-in header `x-rw-stream-mode: stream` from SDK, fallback heuristic: chunked encoding + first-chunk latency > 100ms -> streaming.
Zara: agree on opt-in. also want an idle-reclaim: if stream has no chunks for 150ms, demote its connection weight and let short RPCs use reclaimed workers.
Mina: important: hedging must be disabled while a stream holds a connection weight; duplicates will double the worker consumption.
Harper: retry budget idea: per-route token bucket where tokens are consumed on admission (including retries) and only refilled on successful completes. prevents a failing surge from refilling tokens.
Eli: sample config we can put in route manifest:
```
route: /api/complete
admission:
  connection_weight:
    short: 1
    stream: 8
  request_tokens:
    capacity: 300
    refill_on_success: true
streaming:
  opt_in_header: x-rw-stream-mode
  idle_reclaim_ms: 150
  disable_hedging: true
retry_policy:
  max_attempts: 2
  early_reject_non_idempotent: true
```
Zara: telemetry: emit `conn_weight`, `tokens_consumed`, `idle_reclaims`, `stream_detected` per request for dashboards.
Mina: graceful fallback: if stream token pool exhausted, return 429 + Retry-After for non-SDK clients, SDKs can request `enqueue=true` to get 202.
Eli: rollout plan: feature flag `edge.stream_admission_v1`, start at 1% on internal traffic. add chaos test simulating lots of idle streams.
Harper: ownership: I'll proto the reclaim logic, Mina can own route config surface, Zara handles traces.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-gateway v1.32.4 to canary with flag edge.stream_admission_v1=false.
Mina: OK. Harper + Eli sync after spike sims. will open RFC with config API and expected failure modes.
